acceptance: An unknown family or a negative weight fails the strict load and names the key.
No policy key gives the defaults.
fix: Register telemetry.token_weights.<family> with four weights (input, output, cache_read, cache_write) and the defaults 1, 5, 0.1 and 1.25. The report reads the weights from the policy; no weight is a Go literal outside the default.
